DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: lights in the night
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Unknown lights have appeared among the distant ridges for several nights in succession.

li.label: Send an investigation party
li.description: Send a well-armed group to locate the source.

li.label: Light a signal in response
li.description: Divert core operations to keep a bright answering signal active.

li.label: Black out and stand guard
li.description: Extinguish every light and divert workers to security.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: shrine in the woods
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The lights came from a ritual held by nearby tribespeople. Offerings surround a totem, and the few guards present remain watchful.

li.label: Attack them
li.description: Overrun the lightly guarded ritual and seize its offerings.

li.label: Approach peacefully
li.description: Make peaceful contact with those attending the ritual.

li.label: Ignore them
li.description: Leave the ritual undisturbed.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: graveyard lights
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The strange glow comes from a forgotten burial ground, where marsh gas burns between broken headstones like wandering spirits.

li.label: Investigate
li.description: Search the burial ground despite the danger.

li.label: Repair the graves
li.description: Set the markers upright and restore some dignity to the site.

li.label: Ignore it
li.description: Leave the dead and their lights alone.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: crashed transport
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The investigation party found an old transport overturned in a ravine. Its crew is long gone and some holds remain intact, but large animal tracks surround the wreck.

li.label: Drive off the beasts and search thoroughly
li.description: Secure the wreck and empty every intact hold.

li.label: Quickly dismantle the wreck
li.description: Take the easiest metal and machinery, then withdraw.

li.label: Mark the route and clear the site
li.description: Turn the discovery into a safer, faster route.

li.label: Do not risk it
li.description: Withdraw without approaching the wreck.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: hidden hunting ground
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The strange traces belong to migrating animals resting in a sheltered valley, creating a brief and abundant hunting ground.

li.label: Organize a driven hunt
li.description: Surround the herd and harvest as much as possible.

li.label: Record the migration route
li.description: Study the herd and document its route.

li.label: Avoid disturbing the herd
li.description: Let the animals continue their migration undisturbed.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: mistaken miracle
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Nearby tribespeople saw the restored signal and took it for a divine manifestation. They gather around the equipment and leave offerings.

li.label: Intimidate them
li.description: Use the signal equipment to produce a display of light and sound, frightening them into leaving their offerings behind.

li.label: Tell them the truth
li.description: Explain the machinery. They conclude that they have been deceived.

li.label: Use the opportunity to make contact
li.description: Welcome the gathering and establish new ties.

li.label: Ignore them
li.description: Take no part in the gathering.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: silence
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The signal flashes regularly for a long while, but nothing answers on the horizon. Perhaps no one is watching, or perhaps they chose to remain silent.

li.label: Keep the signal going
li.description: Maintain the signal a little longer.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: the travelers' answer
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Several days later, a traveling party follows the signal to the outpost. They do not know who restored the equipment, but are willing to trade.

li.label: Open a temporary market
li.description: Invite the travelers to trade at the outpost.

li.label: Exchange supplies
li.description: Trade a load of steel for assorted supplies.

li.label: Ask them to spread the word
li.description: Ask the travelers to tell others about the outpost.

li.label: Bid them a polite farewell
li.description: Part on courteous terms without making a deal.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: distress signal
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Soon after the signal is lit, the equipment receives a broken reply. Someone nearby has suffered an accident and is trying to locate the outpost.

li.label: Send a rescue team
li.description: Dispatch an armed team to bring the survivor back.

li.label: Provide directions only
li.description: Guide the stranded survivor toward safer territory.

li.label: Demand payment
li.description: Offer help only in return for valuables.

li.label: Remain silent
li.description: Do not answer the call.
